While one person is searched for, the whole group stops. Searching and waiting are a cost.
Departures are noticed late. On cable cars and in mountains, nobody even knows the location.
Roll call at every stop. Service quality drops while fatigue rises.
Lost elderly travelers often miss calls, and children have no phone. The answer isn't there when it matters most.

단말을 고르는 상품이 아니라,<br><span class=\"hl\">일:
Not a product where you pick devices,
an operations system where the itinerary sets the mode.
여행사나 학교는 상품 유형과 일정만 고릅니다. 일정에 “위험 구간” 표시: Travel agencies and schools only pick a product type and an itinerary. When the itinerary marks a "risky stretch" or a tag drifts away from the guide, the tag switches mode on its own. "Should we rent Keep Tag, Keep Tag+ or Shelter?" is no longer a question the agency has to answer.
착용하고, 필요할 때 버튼 하나: Wear it, and press one button when needed
할 일은 출발 전 동의, 착용, 그리고 길을 잃거나 다쳤을 때 버튼 3초: All they do is consent before departure, wear the tag, and hold the button for 3 seconds if they get lost or hurt. No app, no login, no charging.

태그는 가이드 휴대폰(허브)에 BLE로 신호를 보내고, 허브에서 멀어진: Tags signal the guide's phone (the hub) over BLE, and only a Keep Tag+ that drifts away from the hub reports its location directly over LTE. In the cloud, the itinerary and geofence engine builds a fence for each scene, and the alert engine filters events into 3 levels before passing them to guides, families and agencies.
Keep Tag+의 모드는 일정과 허브 거리로 자동 전환됩니다: Keep Tag+ switches modes automatically based on the itinerary and distance from the hub
Near the hub, only BLE is on. Battery use is almost zero.
허브에서 180초 넘게 멀어지면 GNSS를 2분 간격으로 켜고 LTE로: If away from the hub for more than 180 seconds, GNSS turns on every 2 minutes and reports over LTE.
Only on the itinerary's risky stretches: tracking every minute plus fall detection.

허브에서 180초 넘게 멀어지면 추적을 시작하고, 긴급·주의·정보로 나눠: After 180 seconds away from the hub, tracking starts and alerts are split into Urgent, Caution and Info. See the last location on the map right away.

We ran each of 10 teams' itineraries 241 times under four conditions — manual, Keep Tag, Keep Tag+ and Shelter — and added 7 sensitivity analyses. Most of the effect came not from automating attendance but from knowing where people who drifted away during free time were.
자유시간 사고가 난 팀에서 Keep Tag는 거의 효과가 없고, Keep: In teams with free-time incidents, Keep Tag barely helps, while Keep Tag+ cuts risk by 39–58%
수동 운영 대비 위험 노출이 몇 % 줄었는지 · 팀별 241회 평균 ·: How much risk exposure fell compared with manual operation (%) · average of 241 runs per team · hover over a dot to see the actual values (manual → condition)
한 줄이 한 팀의 여행입니다. 회색 점은 Keep Tag, 숫자가 붙은: Each row is one team's trip. Gray dots are Keep Tag, purple dots with a number are Keep Tag+, and red-ringed dots are Shelter; the further right, the more risk was reduced. The 5 teams in the shaded area at the top have itineraries that include someone getting separated during free time.
가이드가 직접 호명하며 챙기는 <b>수동 운영의 위험 노출을 100으로: It is how much risk exposure fell, taking manual operation (the guide calling names) as 100. Formula: (manual − condition) ÷ manual × 100. E.g. T06 Gyeongju school trip: manual 396 → Keep Tag+ 167, so (396−167) ÷ 396 ≈ 58% less. 0% means the same as manual, 100% means all risk removed, and a negative value means worse than manual. Each value is the average of 241 runs of the same itinerary under random conditions.
Keep Tag(블루투스 전용)는 가이드 휴대폰 근처에 있을 때만 보입니: Keep Tag (Bluetooth only) is visible only near the guide's phone. When someone wanders far away during free time, nobody knows where they are, so the difference from manual stayed within ±8%. Keep Tag+ (BLE + GPS + cellular) reports the location even when far away, cutting risk exposure by 39–58% in the same teams. Shelter is a mode that switches Keep Tag+ to continuous tracking only on risky stretches.
팀별 Keep Tag, Keep Tag+, Shelter의 위험 노출 감: Risk exposure reduction by team for Keep Tag, Keep Tag+ and Shelter. In the 5 teams with free-time incidents, Keep Tag reduced it by -4 to 8% and Keep Tag+ by 39–58%
Keep121 시뮬레이터 · 10팀 × 4조건 × 241시드, 2026-: Keep121 simulator · 10 teams × 4 conditions × 241 seeds, run on 2026-10-16. All figures come from assumed values and will be calibrated with field samples.
자유시간이 있는 일정은 Keep Tag+가 기본: Keep Tag+ is the default for itineraries with free time
In free-time incident teams, Keep Tag's risk exposure differs from manual by only ±4%, because no one knows where people beyond the guide's range are.
Shelter는 단말이 아니라 “구간 모드”: Shelter is a "stretch mode," not a device
상시 추적 시 산행팀 하루 307mAh, 1.2일이면 방전. 일정에 위험: Tracking all the time drains a hiking team's tag by 307 mAh a day — empty in 1.2 days. It turns on only during stretches marked as risky.
학생 120명 팀 오경보 하루 약 25건, 허브 이탈 대기를 60초로 줄: A 120-student team gets about 25 false alarms a day; cut the hub-exit wait to 60 seconds and it's 100. Three levels + bundling + auto-suppression.
가이드 휴대폰이 핵심 장비: The guide's phone is the key device
